items.statement: Expects EBITDA margin to improve to 17-20% by Q4 FY27 from current 9.7%.
items.quote: So, our expectation is that by Q4, as we currently, we are at about 9.7% EBITDA. So, as we leave the end of Q4, maybe hopefully, we should be able to do closer towards 17% to 20%.

items.statement: Land investment could reach INR1,500-1,600 crores this year if Bangalore and NCR deals close.
items.quote: So, if we are able to complete those transactions, then we might look at closer towards INR1,500 crores to INR1,600 crores this year.

items.statement: INR1,000 crores NCDs to be issued in tranches over next couple of quarters as acquisitions firm up.
items.quote: We envisage the usage coming in the next couple of quarters. So, we would do it in tranches as and when we identify the acquisition opportunity or, let’s say, firm up the acquisition opportunity, we would go ahead with the funding of NCD.

items.statement: Net debt expected to be around zero level for the year.
items.quote: We envisage our net debt to be at about 0 level for this year.

items.statement: Overall demand scenario stable; strong Q1 response due to better launch preparation.
items.quote: Otherwise, the overall demand scenario seems to be quite stable from what we have seen in terms of the launches and also what we are witnessing post the launches also.

items.statement: Margin cash flow lower for forthcoming projects due to higher joint development mix and absence of own-land Hoskote.
items.quote: So, the main difference for the new forthcoming majority -- I mean, the mix of the projects, a greater mix is towards joint development. And hence, that’s the marginal cash flow, you would have seen reduction.

items.statement: Forthcoming launch pipeline of ~20.77 million sq ft across 17 projects; unsold inventory 14.94 million sq ft.
items.quote: We currently have a forthcoming launch pipeline of about 20.77 million square feet across 17 projects.

items.statement: Revenue yet to be recognized from already-sold units stands at INR20,553 crores.
items.quote: As end of this quarter, the company has INR20,553 crores of revenue yet to be recognized from the sales that have already been done.

items.statement: Projected receivable plus unsold value ~INR31,000 crores; remaining cost INR19,000 crores; margin cash flow INR12,000 crores.

items.statement: Karnataka minimum wage hike may have small cost impact, expected to be absorbed within project budgets.
items.quote: However, it would have a little bit of impact on our overall cost. That is yet to be assessed. But I think we are considering -- it should be -- we should be able to absorb it within the budget that we have allocated for the projects.

items.statement: Other businesses revenue expected similar to last financial year this year.
items.quote: In the steady-state run rate, we expect, in this financial year also to be similar to last financial year in terms of revenue for the other businesses.

items.statement: Exports to move beyond 250,000 units per month this quarter and onwards.
items.quote: we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards

items.statement: Capacity expansion from 7 million to 9 million units per annum across businesses.
items.value: 7 million to 9 million units per annum
items.quote: we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum

items.statement: New 125cc Pulsar plus upgrades, and 2 new 125cc brands within FY27.
items.quote: an absolutely new 125cc will be introduced in the Pulsar brand, along with a couple of new upgrades

items.statement: Pricing actions offset nearly half of Q1 commodity inflation of ~4.5% of revenue.
items.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

items.statement: Demand environment positive in domestic and international key markets; outlook promising.
items.quote: the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile

items.statement: Supply chain and logistics disruptions impaired availability by 10-15% in Q1.
items.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

items.statement: Electric two- and three-wheeler portfolio EBITDA margin remains double digit; Chetak now EBITDA positive.
items.quote: our EBITDA margin for the electric portfolio business comprising two and three-wheelers continues to remain double digit as we had queued in the last quarter

items.statement: Chetak demand exceeds supply; capacity expansion underway for domestic and international growth.
items.quote: Demand, however, continued to remain ahead of our ability to supply.

items.statement: Chetak exclusive stores to expand from ~530-550 to 1,000 in a couple of years.
items.quote: which is at about, I think, 530 - 550 stores to 1,000 stores. I can see 1,000 stores coming in a couple of years.

items.statement: 100% payout ratio of FY26 profit via base dividend plus buyback; cash to rebuild to ~INR15,000 crores by FY-end.
items.quote: I expect it to really build back to INR15,000 crores thereabouts by the end of the financial year, at levels that you've been used to seeing at the end of each financial year.

items.statement: KTM turnaround progressing; manufacturing ramped up, dealer/plant inventory normalization largely complete.
items.quote: Manufacturing has now progressively ramped up through the year and is approaching underlying retail demand.

items.statement: On track to deliver FY27 capacity addition target of 3 GW and capex of ₹20,000 crore.
items.quote: We remain firmly on track to deliver our FY27 annual target of 3 GW capacity addition and ₹20,000 crore capex — having already achieved close to 36% of the FY27 capacity guidance, and surpassed about 87% of the total capacity added in all of FY26.

items.statement: Next year capacity addition expected in similar range of 3 GW.
items.quote: Yes, it will be in the same range. It will be in this range only.

items.statement: Completed ₹10,150 crore capital raise; ₹1,875 crore promoter preferential tranche pending until June 2027.
items.quote: This comprised three components. First, a preferential allotment to promoters of ₹3,000 crore, of which ₹1,125 crore has already been received, with the balance to come in before June 2027.

items.statement: Mahanadi expansion capex to be 25-30% lower than greenfield benchmark while doubling capacity to 3,600 MW.
items.quote: As compared to that, Mahanadi, when we will be completing, I can say definitely that we will be at least 25% to 30% lower while doubling the capacity from 1,800 MW to 3,600 MW.

items.statement: Received first large external order of about ₹440 crore for 5 GWh battery plant.
items.quote: On the 5 G Wh battery plant which we have commissioned in Q4FY26, we have received our first large external order of about ₹ 440 crore.

items.statement: BESS assembly margin expected at $2.75-3 per kWh, yielding ~₹150 crore annual EBITDA.
items.quote: So I think here, in terms of the margin in dollar terms, it's in the range of about $2.75 to $3. If you look at the overall capacity running, it will be about $15 million in a year. So that's how we are saying you can get about close to ₹ 150-odd crores of EBITDA from this project.

items.statement: India power demand grew 8.5% YoY in Q1 FY27; July month-till-date growth ~12%.
items.quote: India's power sector delivered a strong start to FY27, with Q1 demand growing 8.5% year-on-year — a sharp turnaround from the muted 0.9% growth in FY26.

items.statement: Long-term power demand CAGR expected at 5-6%.
items.quote: India's industrialisation, urbanisation, and rising per capita consumption underpin a clear 5–6% long-term CAGR in power demand.

items.statement: Hydro generation declined 26% YoY due to weak hydrology; recovery expected with monsoon.
items.quote: However, overall portfolio generation declined by almost 26% YoY, owing to weak hydrology across the entire basin — national hydro generation was down 7% YoY, Sutlej basin was down 39% YoY, and Ravi basin was down 24% YoY.

items.statement: Coal prices rose 25% YoY (API4 $113 vs $90); mitigated by shift to domestic coal.
items.quote: Coal prices witnessed a year-on-year increase. Taking a specific index like API4 as a reference, it stood at $90 in Q1 FY26 compared to $113 in Q1 FY27 — an increase of about 25%.

items.statement: Renewables now 61% of 14.6 GW installed capacity; thermal 5.7 GW provides baseload.
items.quote: With the sizeable capacity that we added, our total installed capacity now stands at about 14.6 GW, with renewables constituting around 61%, complemented by 5.7 G W of thermal capacity providing reliable, dispatchable baseload.

items.statement: Net leverage improved to 4.95x from 5.2x; committed to below 5x by 2030.
items.quote: Our balance sheet discipline continues to strengthen, with net operating leverage on a trailing-twelve-month basis improving to 4.95x, from approximately 5.2x in FY26, even as we scale up our growth investments. By year 2030, we are committed to have our net leverage below 5 times.

items.statement: Pumped storage projects offer significantly high-teen IRRs; capex ~₹5 crore per MW.
items.quote: In terms of when we say benchmark returns of mid-teen IRRs, here, I can say it will be significantly high-teen IRRs, we can say, is what we are absolutely confident with the tariff and the cost at which the most of the ordering has already happened.

items.statement: Housing.com to become profitable within four to six quarters; internal target three to four quarters.
items.quote: However, Aurum and Housing teams have developed an integration plan to make Housing LOOKUP in becoming profitable within four to six quarters.

items.statement: Company-level profitability possible in next two to three quarters, better guidance after Housing close.
items.quote: Yes, we do see the potential to be profitable at a company level because our existing businesses are already profitable, may it be in the distribution segment which always was profitable and now the rental segment is al so break-even at an adjusted EBITDA basis.

items.statement: INR 1,000 crores ARR target to be achieved faster and surpassed with Housing.com.
items.quote: Ishan, the INR 1,000 crores ARR target, you know, we feel that we're going to achieve that a lot faster with Housing.com transaction and surpass it a lot more.

items.statement: Revenue projections anticipated to be surpassed as flywheel adds consumers.
items.quote: But again, it's early days; we see a lot of ancillary revenue that is coming from Aurum PropTech into Housing and also Housing benefiting us at various subsidiary businesses, and as the flywheel keeps on getting us more consumers on the platform, we do, we do anticipate that our revenue projections will be surpassed.

items.statement: Tax rate and carry-forward losses guidance to be articulated in Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We will be able to articulate our clear positions in Q3, starting H2, when we are able to look at our long-term goals on the financial metrics of this business.

items.statement: PBT margins expanded 1,590 bps and adjusted EBITDA margins improved 1,320 bps, driven by fundamentals.
items.quote: PBT margins expanded by 1,590 basis points, while adjusted EBITDA margins improved by 1,320 basis points, reflecting the operating leverage beginning to emerge across the platform.

items.statement: Margins improved 1,000+ bps in Q1 FY27; unit economics to strengthen over coming years.
items.quote: Despite Q1 being the industry's softest quarter, our margins improved by 1,000+ basis points.

items.statement: Promoter subscribing to create INR 200+ crores war chest for Housing; not envisaged to be used.
items.quote: So yes, we'll have INR 200 odd crores of war chest for Housing, but I don't envisage to use this.

items.statement: REA Group now holds 24.9% after PropTiger and Housing share swaps; dilution to largest PropTech group.
items.quote: So, what we have effectively done, we have today on our cap table 24.9% shareholder which is probably the largest PropTech group in the world and one of the biggest media groups in the world.

items.statement: Housing.com annualized burn INR 200 crores; plan to streamline costs to break-even in 4-6 quarters.
items.quote: So as of right now, you know, the business as is, it's doing INR 200 crores of burn annualized basis. This of course, you know, once we close and we start our operations, the idea is to streamline the costs and bring it to a break-even point in four to six quarters.

items.statement: Housing FY25 revenue INR 343 crores, expenses INR 531 crores; FY26 numbers being audited.
items.quote: Having said that, if we look at the FY 2025 revenue from operations at Housing.com between the listing services and various other factors, INR 343 crores was the revenue as of FY '25.

items.statement: India has 2.5 crore property transactions yearly; 1.2 crore digitally addressable; only 7-10 lakh online intermediated.
items.quote: India witnesses approximately 2.5 crore s property transactions every year, of which nearly 1.2 crores transactions are expected to become digitally addressable. Today, however, only 7 to 10 lakh residential transactions are actively intermediated through online portals, highlighting how early digital penetration remai

items.statement: Housing.com has 24% online portal market share, 58 million monthly visits, 12 million app MAU.
items.quote: Housing.com already commands approximately 24% of India's online portal market, supported by one of the country's strongest consumer brands, attracting over 58 million average monthly visits and 12 million monthly active users on its app.

items.statement: Sell.do gross churn 7%, crossed 1,000 developers and 11,800+ active licenses.
items.quote: The churn at agross level was 7%, but Sell.do has been growing in terms of licenses as well as number of developers that are onboarded onto the platform. Sell.do has now crossed 1,000 developers onboarded onto the platform with 11,800+ active licenses that are there currently.

items.statement: Specialty diagnostics ambition to reach 15-20% of portfolio in three to five years.
items.quote: I think our ambition would be to reach the same levels in the three to five year timeline.

items.statement: Holds mid-to-high teens revenue growth guidance for FY27, too early to revise.
items.quote: I will still hold to the mid to high teens guidance at this point in time.

items.statement: Franchisee additions expected around 500-700 per quarter; Q3 typically difficult.
items.quote: So you can consider 500 to 700 as an average addition every quarter.

items.statement: Franchisee additions for year: 700 in Q1, 500 in Q2, 0 in Q3, 500 in Q4.
items.value: 700 in Q1, 500 in Q2, 0 in Q3, 500 in Q4
items.quote: No. 700 in Q1, 500 in Q2, 0 in Q3, 500 in Q4.

items.statement: Most specialty diagnostics capex already done; no significant capex expected next year.
items.quote: But I don't anticipate the significant amount of capex going into this business at least next year.

items.statement: Specialty segment margins expected in line with current EBITDA margin, not dilutive.
items.quote: No. It will actually be more or less in line with our current EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Entered NIPT at less than half existing market prices to make specialty affordable.
items.quote: We came in at a price that is actually less than half of the existing prices of players in that market.

items.statement: Thyroid mix fell from 20% to low single digits; shift to semi-specialized tests.
items.quote: if you go back 4 years ago, thyroid used to be 20% of our mix. Today, it's low single digits.

items.statement: Radiology divestment process expected to take at least six months; no buyer yet.
items.quote: I anticipate the process will take 6 months, right? But we don't have any definitive what you call buyer at this point in time.

items.statement: API Holdings debt reduced from INR1,800 crores to INR1,050 crores; IPO at least 12 months away.
items.quote: We were at INR1,700 crores debt last year. We are now INR1,800 crores debt last year. We are now down to INR1,050 crores.

items.statement: Thyrocare branded consumables announcement expected by September.
items.quote: By September, you will see an announcement from us, and I'm sure you will be pleasantly pleased with what we are doing.

items.statement: Radiology PAT expected around INR6 crores for the year.
items.quote: I think INR6 crores PAT is what we can expect for the year, not more.

items.statement: ESOP charge around INR3.5 crores per quarter in P&L.
items.quote: So ESOPs charge -- so it would be around 3.5 crores in the P&L quarter.

items.statement: Specialty diagnostics is a zero year; no targets set yet, few cities started.
items.quote: it is a zero year for specialty. So, considering any numbers basis of what we are doing as of now will be very difficult for me to give you.

items.statement: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of 10% to 15%, with similar growth expected in profits.
items.quote: So we can -- the growth rate is around 10% to 15% for the next this quarter, this year 2027.

items.statement: Management expects revenue to reach INR900-1,000 crores in the next two to three years.
items.quote: Down the next two to three years, you can expect anything around INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores.

items.statement: Management plans annual capex of INR40-50 crores every year going forward.
items.quote: So the capex will be every year we are allocating around INR40 crores to INR50 crores for next every year, it will be like INR40 crores to INR50 crores capital expenditure.

items.statement: Peptide plant at full utilization expected to generate INR200-300 crores revenue at 18-20% EBITDA margin.
items.quote: Once we are to a peak and full utilization of plant, we can expect anything around INR200 crores to INR300 crores of revenue.

items.statement: Cenobamate launch expected to contribute INR10-12 crores revenue in FY27.
items.quote: So the launching quantity and put together this year, it will be around INR10 crores to INR12 crores.

items.statement: Peptide facility with 250 kg per annum capacity targeted for commissioning by Q4 2027, first producing Semaglutide.
items.quote: To commercialize this pipeline, we are getting up a dedicated peptide manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 250 kg per annum, targeted for commissioning by Q4 2027.

items.statement: Oncology API dedicated manufacturing facility targeted for commercialization by Q4 2028.
items.quote: Another key focus area is oncology API where we are building a dedicated manufacturing facility which will commercialize and the target date by Q4 2028.

items.statement: Export share expected to grow from current 18-20% to 30-35% of revenue in near future.
items.quote: So in near future, you can see exports growing to around 30% to 35% and rest will be domestic and formulation.

items.statement: Magnesium L-Threonate business expected to grow 15-20% in FY27.
items.quote: There's a growth of around 15% to 20%.

items.statement: API prices remained stable this quarter; future direction depends on geopolitical situation and oil prices.
items.quote: The API price has been more or less stable during this last quarter as compared to last quarter.

items.statement: Receivable days improved from 145 to 131 days; management anticipates further reduction to 110-120 days.
items.quote: We have come down from 145 days to 131 days as of quarter one of this year. We continue to work with our customers to improve this much further, but we anticipate it to be around 110 to 120 days going forward.

items.statement: Backward integration on 8-10 molecules covering 20-25% of revenue expected to improve margins by 1-2%.
items.quote: You can put together around 20% to 25% will come from that 8 to 10 products and there will be a marginal increase from 1% to 2%.

items.statement: Medium-term objective to scale AUM to INR500-550 crores by end of this fiscal year.
items.quote: Our medium-term objective is very clear, that is to scale AUM towards INR500 to INR550 crores by the end of this fiscal year while maintaining strong asset quality, capital adequacy and governance standards.

items.statement: Expects total revenue upwards of INR75 crores for full FY27.
items.quote: we should be able to deliver upwards of Northwards of INR75 crores on our total revenue in the end of the -- in the entire 12 months period

items.statement: Expects PAT of INR25-30 crores for full FY27.
items.quote: from a bottom line point of view, we should look at anything from a INR25 to INR30 crores kind of a PAT numbers that we can deliver.

items.statement: Expects cost of funds at 12.75%-12.95% by end of next quarter and 11.75%-12.5% by year end.
items.quote: We are hoping by end of the next financial quarter we should be a t around closer to 12.75% to 12.95% and that out by the end of the year we should be at 12.5% between 11.75% to 12.5%.

items.statement: Targets NIM of ~3-3.5% quarterly (10-12% annualized) on MSME portfolio.
items.quote: Our NIMs what it was projected or we want to be at on an MSME portfolio is about close to 3%, 3.5% on a quarterly basis, it is about 10%, 12% in a annualized basis if I have to give that number, okay?

items.statement: Targets gross NPA not exceeding 1.25% and credit cost below 1%.
items.quote: We want to work our GNPA not more than 1.25% and we want to keep our credit cost below 1%.

items.statement: Plans 80% MSME secured and 20% digital lending portfolio mix.
items.quote: Our major portfolio will contribute 80% toward MSME secured portfolio and 20% is in our digital lending platform.

items.statement: Digital lending market for salaried borrowers is over INR50,000-60,000 crores.
items.quote: the organized borrower salaried borrowing our m ethod states that it is more than -- currently it is more than INR50,000 to INR60,000 crores okay.

items.statement: Plans to expand digital lending pin code coverage from 11,000 to 18,000.
items.quote: Today we have just opened pin codes 11,000 pin codes only, right. In the coming year we will touch this to 18,000 pin codes.

items.statement: Applied for PPI license, expects to receive it in 3-5 months.
items.quote: we have applied for a PPI license in Regency Fincorp Limited, we have got the approval, we have already applied for it in next three to four months or five months time we should get the PPI license.

items.statement: Aims to keep leverage at 3.5x-4x, may raise equity via preferential shares.
items.quote: we are very, very comfortable at 3.5x to 4x kind of a debt race, okay? We will not go beyond 3.5x to 4x of our leverage first of all, okay?

items.statement: Digital lending opex plus acquisition cost is 4% of APR.
items.quote: 4% is my opex plus my digital expense cost towards acquisition of a customer.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA breakeven in Express business this financial year.
items.quote: we are working very hard towards an EBITDA break-even in this financial year, and we are very confident that target should be achieved by us.

items.statement: Aims to reduce white space by 95% by September 2026 from 1.6 million sq ft.
items.quote: we are firmly on our track to achieve our glide path on reducing our white space by 95% by September '26 to the point where we started in quarter 1 of last year.

items.statement: Expects 150-200 bps gross margin expansion in medium term.
items.quote: We have said that 150 to 200 bps is kind of the expansion that we are looking at in the gross margin from a medium-term perspective, and we will continue to maintain that view overall.

items.statement: Plans to continue PAT positivity and improve operating performance.
items.quote: we will work towards continuing our trajectory of PAT positivity and improvement in operating performance.

items.statement: Sees strong tailwind from Mahindra's auto and tractor business growth.
items.quote: when Mahindra's auto and tractor business does so well, obviously, that has a very big tailwind for us. So, we will benefit from that. And hopefully, that will continue through the year.

items.statement: Winning new customers in e-commerce, manufacturing, and telecom verticals.
items.quote: we are winning a lot of business from e-commerce customers. So, we don't share that business wise, but I can broadly tell you that we have done very good work on e-commerce.

items.statement: Passed on fuel cost increase to 80% of B2B Express customers.
items.quote: Broadly, we have got the fuel escalation passed on for 80% of our customer even in B2B.

items.statement: Faced manpower shortages, site ramp-up, and wage revisions causing margin compression.
items.quote: the business has faced some headwinds driven by manpower shortages, site ramp-up and minimum wage revisions resulting in some margin compression.

items.statement: Last Mile Delivery revenue declined 16% Y-o-Y due to strategic exit from low-margin business.
items.quote: In our Last Mile Delivery business, LMD, as we call it, revenue moderation, we had a degrowth of 16% Y-o-Y was a conscious strategic choice

items.statement: Mahindra & Mahindra contributes close to 60% of business.
items.quote: We have close to 60% business from Mahindra.

items.statement: Withdrawing from Mumbai Airport taxi service as it didn't meet internal thresholds.
items.quote: we are withdrawing from Mumbai Airport. if you would have noticed, if you were transiting through Mumbai Airport, we had a Alyte service available. As I speak to you, we are withdrawing from that airport.

items.statement: Revised ROA guidance for exit Q4 FY27 to 1.2-1.4% due to external factors.
items.quote: Based on this visibility available, we believe an ROA in the range of 1.2% to 1.4% of the exit of Q4FY27 would be probable.

items.statement: Full year FY27 credit growth guidance maintained at 14%, with EEB 5-10% and non-EEB 20%+.
items.quote: On the credit growth, what we had guided was for the full year FY 27, we were looking at a 14% growth rate, within which EEB, we were looking at between a 5% to 10% growth and non-EEB would be 20% plus.

items.statement: Expects to hold NIM at 6.2% achieved in Q1; no further improvement expected.
items.quote: I think it will be a great achievement for the bank to hold on to the NIMs that we have achieved during this particular quarter.

items.statement: No MFI yield hike in Q1; last hike of 100 bps in Feb 2026.
items.quote: So, it is same as of the last year. We have not hiked anything during the quarter.

items.statement: Cost of funds pressure from deposit rate competition; savings bank cost up 20 bps QoQ.
items.quote: Q2, we have to see whether we will get because my savings bank cost of funds have already gone up by almost 20 basis points QoQ.

items.statement: Strategy to maintain EEB at 33-35% and non-EEB at 65-67% of book.
items.quote: The portfolio mix, the strategy remains the same. We'll go to one-third that is 33% to 35% of EEB book and 65% non-EEB book.

items.statement: Target 40% unsecured and 60% secured mix.
items.quote: So, the strategy remains the same - 40% unsecured and 60% secured.

items.statement: Cautious on EEB growth due to external environment; will grow 5-10% if conditions improve.
items.quote: So the question is that we will grow. Definitely, if the situation improves, we may grow up to 10% also.

items.statement: External factors like energy crisis and monsoon may impact ROA; credit cost guidance unchanged at 1.6-1.8%.
items.quote: And therefore, our credit cost guidance of 1.6% to 1.8%, that continues to remain. So we are not changing that.

items.statement: Expects 10-20 bps improvement in other income and marginal credit cost reduction to drive ROA.
items.quote: So, we do expect 10 to 20 basis points improvement to come through other income.

items.statement: Opex to asset ratio may remain at 4.3% for next year, taper from FY28.
items.quote: At least for the next 1 year, probably it will be remain at the same level because till we reach a certain level of business. But yes, then it will come coming down. So I think we were expecting that it should taper down from the FY28.

items.statement: IT cost to opex at 8-9.5%, may remain within 10%.
items.quote: Right now, and including the depreciation, it is around 9.5%.

items.statement: One-time gratuity provision of INR 61 crores due to new wage code, not expected to repeat.
items.quote: In addition to this, there was a INR 61 crores of additional one time gratuity provision due to the changes in the salary structure driven by the new wage code.

items.statement: On track to add 5 GW greenfield RE capacity this year, excluding BESS and pump storage.
items.quote: We remain on track to add 5 GW of greenfield capacity this year.

items.statement: Targets 10-plus GW-hour cumulative battery storage capacity this financial year.
items.quote: With this momentum, we are well positioned to achieve our 10-plus GW-hour target this year.

items.statement: Maiden 500 MW pump storage project at Chitravathi to be commissioned this financial year.
items.quote: We are also on schedule to commission our maiden 500 MW pump storage project at Chitravathi, Andhra Pradesh, in this financial year.

items.statement: FY27 capex guidance of about INR42,000 crore for 5 GW RE and 10 GW-plus battery capacity.
items.quote: the FY '27 guidance is about INR42,000 crores of Capex to be done for FY '27 because we are looking at about 5 GW of expansion in RE and 10 GW plus we want to reach as a cumulative capacity in batteries.

items.statement: Run-rate EBITDA expected to rise from INR17,000 crore now to INR21,000 crore by FY27 end.
items.quote: our current run-rate EBITDA for the operational portfolio is about INR17,000 crore. For the expected for the FY '27, it is about INR21,000 crore.

items.statement: BESS EBITDA thumb rule of INR25-30 lakh per MW-hour for FY27 based on capitalization.
items.value: INR25 lakh to INR30 lakh per MW-hour
items.quote: It's about INR25 lakh to INR30 lakh per MW-hour in that range where the EBITDA would come in based on the capitalization that takes place over the next nine months of the year.

items.statement: Curtailment currently impacts overall EBITDA by 5-7%; expected to end from Khavda by this calendar year.
items.quote: a curtailment has an impact of in the range of 5% to 7% on our overall EBITDA as we speak.

items.statement: Merchant capacity de-risked by contracting with AESL; solar/wind 25-year fixed, battery 15-year fixed.
items.quote: in case of batteries, it is for 15 years and fixed for that period. And, in case of solar and wind, it is for 25 years and fixed for the price at a rate.

items.statement: Infirm power sold at merchant rates around INR2.5 per unit including RECs.
items.quote: the current is in line with what the merchant power is selling through, including the RECs. It varies, but it is in the range of INR2.5 per unit.

items.statement: Battery storage arbitrage economics of INR4-5 per unit based on 12-36 month market trends.
items.quote: they tend to be anywhere between INR4 to INR5 is the arbitrage that you tend to get for these projects, and they are economically viable arbitrages on which we are working.

items.statement: Battery capex thumb rule of about INR1.5 crore per MW-hour of installed capacity.
items.quote: a reasonable good thumb rule would be INR1.5 crores per MW-hour of installed capacity.

items.statement: Additional 7 GW transmission evacuation expected by end of this calendar year, balance in a quarter or two.
items.quote: I think we do expect, by the end of this year, another 7 GW, which is going to come. That is this calendar year. And another quarter or two, the balances should be there online.

items.statement: Rooftop solar growth not seen disrupting utility-scale or C&I demand; both can grow independently.
items.quote: we don't foresee that distributed generation of a rooftop is going to disrupt the overall market of energy requirement in this country.

items.statement: Battery fire risk addressed; incident was PCS/IGBT failure not battery; insurance and Tier-1 OEM warranties in place.
items.quote: insurance, like it is covered for any other equipment, it is covered by standard insurance policies, including for battery projects.

items.statement: Guides FY27 disbursement growth of 22-23% and AUM growth of 17-18%.
items.quote: For the next nine months, we are committed to delivering our yearly commitment of 22% to 23% top line growth and that remains steadfast on disbursement and that moves to about 17%-18% on AUM.

items.statement: Medium-term sustainable AUM growth guidance of 20%.
items.quote: These improvements give us confidence that Aavas is well positioned to accelerate growth and deliver sustainable 20% growth over the medium term.

items.statement: Expects spread to fall slightly below 5% due to competition.
items.quote: As I look for the complete year, I do believe that spread compression from the existing point will take spread to go sub-5%.

items.statement: Spread expected to fall a tad below 5%.
items.quote: Yes, I do think it will fall a tad below 5%.

items.statement: Focus on regaining home loan market share; HL/NHL mix targeted at 65:35.
items.quote: I want to be absolutely comfortable on both on-boarding business metrics between HL and NHL, to tend towards what the portfolio is, which is roughly 65-35.

items.statement: Implemented 10 bps PLR cut effective June 2026; cumulative 25 bps reduction since March 2026.
items.quote: During the quarter, we implemented an additional 10-basis point reduction in our PLR, effective June 2026, taking the cumulative reduction of 25-basis point since March 2026 and passing on the benefit for the interest of the customer.

items.statement: Plans to double field resource productivity from Rs 8-10 lakh to Rs 20-22 lakh in two years.
items.quote: So, there could be large branches, small branches, there from an average of about Rs. 8-10 lakhs productivity per resource, we are looking at doubling this to at least Rs. 20 to 22 lakhs per resource deployed on the field.

items.statement: Proactively changed underwriting policy for segments affected by West Asia conflict and rainfall shortfall.
items.quote: Towards the same, in the early part of February, proactively the teams have made certain policy changes looking at the macro environment, certain segments, which would be affected by both the ongoing West Asia Conflict as well as the ensuing expectation of shortfall of rainfall.

items.statement: June 2026 disbursements were upwards of Rs 600 crores.
items.quote: Secondly, June numbers are upwards of Rs. 600 crs.

items.statement: RBI circular on asset classification of repossessed assets is under evaluation.
items.quote: Renish, currently this is under evaluation, and we will ensure that if any change must be made, we will make it happen

items.statement: No builder loan product; NHL yields 150-200 bps higher than HL.
items.quote: Shivam, we do not do any builder loan kind of product. And we do have an NHL, LAP or MSME and the difference between HL to NHL, there is anything between 150 to 200-basis point difference is there, but we do not have any builder loan as such.

items.statement: Maintains FY27 EBITDA guidance of INR750-800 crore, with sequential growth expected.

items.statement: First half FY27 EBITDA expected around INR400 crore plus, roughly INR200 crore per quarter.
items.quote: roughly INR200 crore kind of an EBITDA in the first half will be around INR400 crore plus.

items.statement: Expects sequential improvement in revenue and EBITDA over coming quarters, led by Specialty Chemicals and Nutrition.

items.statement: New multipurpose plant on track for commissioning by end of current calendar year.
items.quote: In the new multipurpose plant remains on track for commissioning by the end of current calendar year, further strengthening of our CDMO and Fine Chemicals growth road map.

items.statement: Added 5 new molecules last quarter across pharma, semicon and Personal Care.
items.quote: We added 5 new molecules in the last quarter across pharma, semicon and Personal Care.

items.statement: Targeting INR100 crore of lean savings in FY27.

items.statement: Niacinamide plant already at 50%+ of peak volumes, targeting 70% by end of year.

items.statement: B3 prices up in Q1 with spillover into Q2; possible softening by end Q2, mitigated by mix and cost actions.

items.statement: Large CDMO contract volumes in current quarter will be higher than previous quarter.

items.statement: Large CDMO contract has full protection covering communicated EBITDA expectations if volumes not given.

items.statement: Acetyls/chemical intermediates expected to continue doing well in current quarter on oil and raw material price escalations.

items.statement: Specialty and nutrition to contribute 70-80% of EBITDA mix; chemical intermediates around INR100 crore for the year.

items.statement: Volatility in Acetyl segment poses risk to Q3/Q4 performance despite strong fundamentals.
items.quote: But obviously, there is always a risk if the market go down again in Q3, Q4. So that is why we maintain overall guidance at the levels we discussed.

items.statement: Higher confidence in reaching 15-20% EBITDA margin, possibly sooner; long-term structural margins significantly higher.
items.quote: we have higher confidence of getting to that number and perhaps getting to it sooner and we do think that AI structurally not only accelerates operating leverage, it also expands the opportunity for higher margins over time

items.statement: EBITDA margin was 8% this quarter and will ramp up from here.
items.quote: The thing is that we probably announced 8% of EBITDA margin this quarter. There is going to be a ramp up from here.

items.statement: EBITDA margin adjusted for PIDF improved from 1% to 8% year-on-year.
items.quote: our EBITDA margin adjusted for PIDF went from 1% to 8%.

items.statement: Revenue growth is broad-based across payments, financial services and smaller businesses; aim for even higher.
items.quote: we're seeing that growth pretty much across the board and we think, having achieved this number, we should aim for even higher.

items.statement: Postpaid ramping roughly twice as fast as previous cycle; F28 to meaningfully add revenue and EBITDA.
items.quote: Currently, we are tracking roughly twice as fast. I'm not saying that if it took us 5 years last year, it will take us 2 and a half years.

items.statement: Lending mix roughly 80-20 toward merchant side; consumer credit crossed Jan-24 levels.
items.quote: the most percentage still 80-20 wise would be towards the merchant side.

items.statement: Lending partners now double-digit in both Merchant Loan and Personal Loan.
items.quote: in both Merchant Loan and Personal Loan, we are now a double-digit number of partners and the new partners who have joined more recently are also ramping up very well.

items.statement: Wealth/equity brokerage and mutual fund distribution is a bright spot; size expected in about four quarters.
items.quote: in wealth we seem to be reaching that milestone, and after that four more quarters and then you will see size.

items.statement: Reducing subscription rentals for merchants who generate large financial services revenue.
items.quote: If we are making a large amount of revenue in the form of financial services revenue, then we don't consider subscription rental revenue from merchants as material and say that it's discounted from our side.

items.statement: Payment processing margin has been inching upwards gradually and consistently every quarter.
items.quote: The payment processing margin, as we've discussed in the last few quarters, has been inching upwards gradually, but consistently every quarter.

items.statement: Net payment margin fell from 8.8 bps to 8.4 bps, partly due to merchant plans and tighter revenue recognition.
items.quote: the net payment margins went from 8.8 bps last year to 8.4.

items.statement: Company has INR 13,500 crores cash and is adding significant cash; free cash flow generating.
items.quote: not only do we have INR 13,500 crores of cash, we are now also adding a significant amount of cash.

items.statement: Actively looking for good RoI uses of cash within existing perimeter, mostly organic, maybe few inorganic.
items.quote: We are continuously looking for more opportunities within the business, mostly organic, maybe a few inorganic if there is the right opportunity and right valuation.

items.statement: No clarity on UPI monetization formula; will wait and watch, no materiality assumed.
items.quote: we just said there is no materiality to it as a discussion when you don't know what the formula is. So we'll wait and watch.

items.statement: Indirect expenses to grow much slower than revenue despite sales and marketing investments.
items.quote: With respect to the overall guidance on indirect expenses is that despite investments in sales and marketing, it will grow a lot slower than revenue.

items.statement: Expect to continue improving EBITDA profitability.
items.quote: Like we have said, we do expect to continue to improve EBITDA profitability.

items.statement: Merchant device additions to continue at 25-30 lakhs per year, possibly higher with more investment.
items.quote: So we have said broadly 25 to 30 lakhs additions a year. We're very much within that band and maybe additional investments could make that go even higher.

items.statement: Proactively launched lower APR products and will lead market if competition enters.
items.quote: So second part, I can tell that we already have started and proactively done different lower APR products.

items.statement: Seeing significant upside on consumer side as headwinds turn around.
items.quote: So, now that these things are starting to turn around, we are seeing significant upside on the consumer side.

items.statement: Greater share of credit card processing adds to payment processing costs but also revenue.
items.quote: But as you can imagine, some of the growth that we are seeing in revenue on payments is also coming from, for example, a greater share of credit card processing, which also adds to payment processing costs.

items.statement: Travel business slightly behind expectations due to external factors like higher ticket prices.
items.quote: So that business was slightly behind our expectations, but for external factors.

items.statement: AI makes organization leaner, improving terminal value.
items.quote: And the second catalyst for saying that is because AI just makes you leaner as an organization.

items.statement: Financial services customer number should linearly grow barring aberrations.
items.quote: So, just to clarify, the 7.6 lakh number, we think that, barring any quarterly aberrations, this number should just linearly grow up.

items.statement: Confident overall financial services revenue will grow despite mix effects.
items.quote: But we are confident, overall financial services revenue will grow.

items.statement: Marketing services positive going forward despite travel headwinds.
items.quote: But we are quite positive about marketing services overall going forward.

items.statement: Consumer revenue growth comparable to merchant side, not far behind.
items.quote: Yeah, it is not far behind the merchant side. So, it is not night and day.

items.statement: AGL acquisition may add a couple of percentage points on top of 15% base business growth.
items.quote: So this -- the AGL piece, I think from a guidance standpoint, yes, we can expect an additional couple of percentage points contribution coming in from AGL. We're talking of a 15% on the base business.

items.statement: Group EBITDA margin should improve by at least 100 bps by year end on operating leverage.
items.quote: So hopefully with the operating leverage that we get on this business, EBITDA margin should probably improve by 100 basis points at least by the end of the year.

items.statement: India standalone EBITDA margins expected to stabilize in the 70% range as discretionary spends moderate.
items.quote: As the discretionary spends moderate, we expect the EBITDA margins to stabilize in the 70% range.

items.statement: Current quarter 60.4% group EBITDA margin is a representative sustainable run rate.
items.quote: Therefore, the current quarter's margin is a more r epresentative indicator of the sustainable run rate of the business.

items.statement: Underlying pricing stable; wholesale pricing has held in the 80-120 range for two years.
items.quote: Yes, Ali, see, again, from a wholesale standpoint, this pricing has remained stable in the last two years between the 80 to 120 range, right, per carat.

items.statement: No pricing correction since April-May 2024; pricing remains stable on natural and LGD.
items.quote: Underlying pricing has remained, you know, consistent or constant since the last time we did a correction, which was April-May of 2024 on natural pricing on LGD.

items.quote: I think when you speak to the growers, they're talking of doubling their capacity over the next three, sorry, capacity is the wrong word, doubling their business over the next three years.

items.statement: LGD demand mainly US-led, increasingly from India; lab-grown jewellery growing very fast.
items.quote: Mainly it is US-led, but increasingly from India also. You know, so what is happening is apart from the loose stone certification, we are increasing in our lab -grown jewelry business.

items.statement: LGD certification of larger carats versus natural pointers supports realization improvement.
items.quote: And while in the lab-grown, we do certification of more than a carat and actually more than two carats. So the size makes the difference.

items.quote: So obviously from that context, these 8-10 guys probably will contribute close to 40%, 50% of our revenues.

items.quote: Yes, I think in I think we would have spent around just under 5 crores for the quarter in terms of the marketing spends around the sponsorship events etc etera.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free.
items.quote: The company continues to be debt -free.

items.statement: Targeting turnaround time of two to three days using AI and increased capacity.
items.quote: No, so turnaround time, a decent turnaround time of two to three days is acceptable. And that is what we strive to do.

items.statement: Full-year growth to be in line with historical double-digit performance; no specific percentage guidance.
items.quote: Our growth prospect for the full year remains intact. It will be in line with our historical growth performance and our margins also remains mostly intact.

items.statement: Q1 is the softest quarter; recovery expected in Q2, Q3, Q4.
items.quote: We clearly see this Q1 as the softest quarter for the year. We expect it to from here on only to grow.

items.statement: 60% of full-year order book already in hand for the whole business.
items.quote: When I talked about 60% as a fraction, that's for the whole business.

items.statement: Unit 4 Phase 1 capex outlay of Rs. 1,200 crores, split roughly 50-50 across FY27 and FY28.
items.quote: We have articulated this, roughly about Rs. 1,200 crores is the capex outlay for Unit 4 and this is Phase 1 of Unit 4.

items.statement: FY27 targeted capex close to Rs. 700 crores.
items.quote: FY27 targeted capex for this year will be close to about Rs. 700 crores.

items.statement: Unit 4 to be commissioned by end of FY28, adding 365 KL custom synthesis and 100 KL fermentation.

items.statement: Margins to remain intact this year; confident of defending margins going forward.
items.quote: I don't see any challenge with margins this year.

items.quote: if you look at on an FY27 full year basis, we will be largely around 13% sort of number as a percentage of sales.

items.statement: Underlying demand strong; deliveries deferred to later quarters; capacity utilization to increase.
items.quote: The underlying demand remains strong, with a higher concentration of scheduled deliveries in the latter half of the year.

items.statement: Specialty ingredients to grow decently this year despite supply chain pressures.

items.statement: 10 late-phase molecules; path to commercialization 18-24 months; 4 molecules commercialized last year.
items.quote: Path to commercialization will still be some time away, closer to about 18 months to 24 months. Last year, our customers have commercialized 4 new molecules.

items.statement: One large biotech customer acquired by Big Pharma; impact not material this year, long-term opportunity.
items.quote: However, the impact is not material for the rest of this year.

items.statement: Tax rate to normalize to ~25-25.5% for full year FY27.
items.quote: So, we will have a much more marginalized tax rate of about 25% to 25.5% for this full year.

items.statement: Expects healthy sequential growth in TMT vertical next quarter, driven by new deals from existing clients.
items.quote: Secondly, the TMT performance is bottoming out and we expect healthy sequential growth in TMT the next quarter.

items.statement: License revenue currently 3% of revenue; expects it to increase and become more significant going forward.
items.quote: Our overall license revenues are 3% of revenue. We expect that to go north of that.

items.quote: We have said that we will continue to increase R&D spends as a percentage of revenue, and we will take it to as much as 10% of revenue.

items.quote: The full P&L level, it will be more close to 120 to 130 bps impact. It is for one month in the first quarter. Again, it is effective 1st of June, so it will have three months impact in the second quarter.

items.statement: Expects profitability to continue improving year-over-year over the next few quarters as growth expands.
items.quote: It is a muscle that we have built now, and we expect that profitability will continue to improve over the next few quarters as we continue to expand our growth.

items.quote: Companies are increasing their tech spends. They are going from 4.5% of revenue to maybe up to 6% of revenue, if you look at the overall tech budgets.

items.statement: Deal sizes increasing; larger RFPs coming than seen in the past, expected to show in numbers in coming years.
items.quote: The size of the deals are bigger and the ambition of what they want to get done are also much larger.

items.statement: Some legacy work like ad hoc analysis and dashboards vanishing; AI compressing work and costs.
items.quote: Things like ad hoc analysis, building dashboards, these are the kinds of things that are going to go to zero anytime soon. If not already zero.

items.quote: Asper’s ARR has gone up by 59% to $9 million as of June 2026 versus the same period last year.

items.quote: Qure.ai’s revenue has grown by 160% year-over-year in Q1 2027 to INR 24 crore.

items.quote: As of June 30 th, 2026, we had cash and cash equivalents, including mutual funds and fixed deposits of INR 1,639 crore or $173 million, including IPO proceeds of INR 689 crore.

items.statement: Order inflow guidance of INR 55,000+ crores for FY27 including QRSAM

items.statement: Full-year FY27 capex guided at ₹1,800 crores, expected to stay at similar level next year
items.quote: This year, I think around ₹1,800 crores on the full-year basis.

items.statement: Middle East conflict impact on solvents and freight costs ~1% of EBITDA; expected to persist at least until December
items.quote: Both solvents and the fright on the EBITDA is close to around 1%.

items.quote: it's even backed with orders, so we believe that we'll be able to sell all the 6 to 7.

items.statement: Silver production guidance of 680 tons for FY27 expected to be achieved
items.quote: So looking at that, we can surely say it will not be difficult to achieve the guidance numbers.

items.quote: So the guidance for the year is on the growth project is around USD500 million to USD600 million we are expecting. And during the quarter, we have spent around INR800 crores.

items.quote: So we can see, including mines, somewhere around 650 KT will be about 2.5x of that, so roughly about INR24,000-25,000 crores. But yet, I will wait for that tendering to be done. items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin reached a record 59%

items.statement: Operating margin guidance maintained at 20%-22% for FY27

items.statement: Maintaining FY27 volume growth guidance and INR900 crore capex guidance
items.quote: We are maintaining our guidance which we have provided earlier

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex was INR120 crore
items.quote: Capex was around INR120 crores

items.statement: Net debt guidance maintained at around INR2,000 crore exit for FY27
items.quote: we are not changing our guidance, whatever guidance we have given, I think possibly it was around INR2,000-odd crores, so we are maintaining those guidance

items.statement: Capacity expansion on track for FY29 target of 27.6 million tons

items.quote: our present capacity is around 43-44 megawatt and there are projects which are in the pipeline, which will further help us to increase to around up to 50
